offering_description.value: Affiliated Managers Group offers actively managed investment funds and portfolio management to institutions and individual investors. Its investment management firms manage portfolios across private markets, alternative strategies, and traditional equity and fixed-income markets.

primary_products.value: private market funds; alternative investment funds; equity funds; fixed-income funds; multi-asset funds

primary_services.value: institutional portfolio management; separately managed accounts; investment advisory services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Corporate pension plans, endowments, foundations, insurers, and wealth management firms; B2C: Individual investors and high-net-worth clients; B2G: Public-sector pension plans

end_markets.value: retirement and pensions; wealth management; endowments and foundations; insurance; retail investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Asset-based fees for funds and separate accounts, plus performance-based fees on certain strategies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Manages assets entrusted by institutions and individuals under investment mandates; financial intermediary: Pools institutional and individual investor capital in funds that invest in public and private markets

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Private market investments, liquid alternatives, and actively managed equity, fixed-income, and multi-asset strategies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Institutional sales and client relationship teams; partners / resellers: Financial advisers, broker-dealers, and wealth management platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Investment adviser registration and fund oversight by the SEC and corresponding regulators abroad

notes: The current ownership status of some affiliated investment managers is uncertain.
